profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration and project management tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its core products include Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Trello, which the company describes as forming one connected platform for planning, tracking, and delivering work. The company characterizes its platform as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements.

On the AI side, Atlassian offers Confluence AI, a team wiki product incorporating smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance, and Trello AI, which adds workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management tool. The company also references Rovo AI agents as part of its broader connected platform. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of $5,215,304,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing. Its SEC CIK is 0001650372. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
